question.text: Two dice are tossed once. The probability of getting an even number at the first die or a total of 8 is

solution.text:
Hints: $A=$ getting even no on 1st dice
$$
\mathrm{B}=\text { getting sum } 8
$$
So $|\mathrm{A}|=18 \quad|\mathrm{~B}|=5 \quad|\mathrm{~A} \cap \mathrm{B}|=3$

$$
\text { So } P(A \cup B)=\frac{18+5-3}{36}=\frac{20}{36} \text {}
$$
